scripts.lint: node scripts/oxlint.mjs && bun run format:check && node scripts/check-json-keys.mjs
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run verify:ai && bun run naming && bun run pairs && bun run rule-scopes && bun run sql && bun run architecture && bun run english && bun run markdown && bun run comments && bun run headers && bun run codegen:check && bun run typecheck && bun run knip
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run bundle && bun run unit && bun run sql:live && bun run hooks:live && bun run codex-trust:live && bun run acceptance
scripts.ci:static: bun run check && bun run bundle && bun run sql:live && bun run hooks:live && bun run codex-trust:live
scripts.ci:unit: bun run bundle && bun run unit
scripts.ci:acceptance: bun run bundle && bun run acceptance
scripts.acceptance: node --test --test-timeout=60000 server/evals/acceptance/shard-1.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-2.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-3.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-4.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-5.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-6.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-7.ts server/evals/acceptance/shard-8.ts
scripts.mutation: bun install --cwd tools/mutation --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && node tools/mutation/node_modules/@stryker-mutator/core/bin/stryker.js run tools/mutation/stryker.config.mjs
